title: Give Elaine a hint

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Hi! Are you ready to give me some good news?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hi! Are you ready to give me some good news?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I don't want you disturbing my staff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I don't want you disturbing my staff.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I don't want you disturbing my staff.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I don't want you disturbing my staff.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Roberta wants her privacy.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Roberta wants her privacy.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: What? She has star potential. She is wasting her life here.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What? She has star potential. She is wasting her life here.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: She needs to understand this! And so do you!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She needs to understand this! And so do you!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She understands. It's not for her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She understands. It's not for her.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She understands. It's not for her.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She understands. It's not for her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's her decision, accept it!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's her decision, accept it!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No. My decision is final.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. My decision is final.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: I need to talk with her. Set up a meeting. Just the two of us.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need to talk with her. Set up a meeting. Just the two of us.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: That's very hard to accept.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That's very hard to accept.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I feel like you're not accustomed to hearing "no."

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I feel like you're not accustomed to hearing "no."
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I feel like you're not accustomed to hearing "no."
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I feel like you're not accustomed to hearing "no."

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Accept it.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Accept it.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: I am not happy. But I respect your clarity on this.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I am not happy. But I respect your clarity on this.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: I'm not. You're right. Very astute.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I'm not. You're right. Very astute.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: You're causing unrest among my staff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: You're causing unrest among my staff.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: You're causing unrest among my staff.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: You're causing unrest among my staff.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Some of your staff want to take Roberta's place.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Some of your staff want to take Roberta's place.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Could you take one of them?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Could you take one of them?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Could you take one of them?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Could you take one of them?

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: I only want Roberta. And... I suppose I can't have her. My search for the new face of my campaign must begin again from scratch.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I only want Roberta. And... I suppose I can't have her. My search for the new face of my campaign must begin again from scratch.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Do you know the Alex-Twins?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you know the Alex-Twins?

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Who?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Who?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Alexander and Alexandria. Bouncers. They are twins. Lots of star quality.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Alexander and Alexandria. Bouncers. They are twins. Lots of star quality.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Alexander and Alexandria. Bouncers. They are twins. Lots of star quality.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Alexander and Alexandria. Bouncers. They are twins. Lots of star quality.

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Hmmm... I will check them out. Thank you. And please tell Roberta that the door is always open for her.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm... I will check them out. Thank you. And please tell Roberta that the door is always open for her.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Please don't disturb ANY of my staff.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Please don't disturb ANY of my staff.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Please don't disturb ANY of my staff.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Please don't disturb ANY of my staff.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She doesn't want to talk to you.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She doesn't want to talk to you.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She doesn't want to talk to you.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She doesn't want to talk to you.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Would you like to hear a suggestion?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Would you like to hear a suggestion?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Would you like to hear a suggestion?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Would you like to hear a suggestion?

nodes.speaker: Elaine Malloy
nodes.text: Hmmm...

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hmmm...
